sentence: This project studies how short-term alcohol and long-term drinking affect specific cells and molecules within prefrontal cortex neural circuits.
This project studies how wild bird viruses form, spread through transmission and migratory movement, and spill over into mammals and agriculture.
This project builds AI methods to mine single-nuclei sequencing data and tests how opioid exposure and HIV infection change gene regulation.
This project uses natural language processing and machine learning to build a tool that predicts the risk of Fontan failure from electronic health records.
This project builds a type of electron microscope that makes connectomes of mouse brains cheaper and faster.
This project tries to make marmosets that carry the precise human mutation found in Huntington’s disease, to model its social and cognitive deficits.
This project develops a synthetic biology medicine that delivers colonization factor antigen I to induce T regulatory cells against rheumatoid arthritis.
This project studies whether maternal obesity raises the risk of osteoarthritis in offspring by changing the cells of the developing knee joint.
This project tests how well a school-based water-promotion intervention works and whether it lasts.
This project develops monoclonal antibodies that could protect against a wide range of henipaviruses, such as Nipah and Hendra viruses.
This project tries to improve treatment for cancer and serious mental illness through collaborative care in community settings.
This project studies coping behavior in youth experiencing homelessness and builds an app that sends messages to prevent drug use.
This project builds computational methods that predict how genes and drugs work together, to help find combination therapies.
This project expands the use of a protein crystallization chaperone to help determine high-resolution protein structures.
This project identifies RNA modifications and splicing events that regulate pancreatic islet function in rodent models of diabetes and human islet cells.
This project uses machine learning to predict islet function from protein abundances and studies transketolase, an enzyme that inhibits insulin secretion.
This project studies chromosomal rearrangements in the Aedes aegypti mosquito genome, including how they spread across the global tropics.
This project studies how glutamine metabolism in muscle stem cells becomes dysfunctional with aging and whether restoring it rejuvenates aged stem cells.
This project studies how a guanine nucleotide exchange modulator helps macrophages respond to infections and calm inflammation.
